newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are likely to rally on expected buying by both retail and institutional investors when the market reopens on Saturday, after Thursday's public holiday and the Friday Moslem weekend, brokers said.
"The investors may exercise their buying options as most of the scrips are very attractive after a recent fall," said broker Mahbub Morshed.

Brokers said scrips in leather and pharmaceutical sectors might rise. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 21.96 points or 2.34 percent up at 957.48 on turnover of 55.1 million taka on Wednesday.
